19,543 reviews. 4.5 stars. And most tourists still walk past the cable car line thinking it's just a ride.

Sunworld Hòn Thơm is a full day out. The world's longest non-stop cable car crosses open ocean to an island water park. Ancient Rome theming, slides, wave pools, shopping, the works.

Book the combo ticket. Arrive early. Beat the midday heat.
